front: Give the call-up format to Düsseldorf Tower.
back:
**Düsseldorf Tower, D-EAZF.**
Station called, then own call sign.

back: Only **one party transmits at a time**.

back: Only when approved, except at the **final parking position**.

front: List radiotelephony message priority from highest to lowest.
back:
1 Distress · 2 Urgency · 3 Direction finding
4 Flight safety · 5 Meteorological
6 Flight regularity.

tip: Mnemonic: D-U-D-F-M-R.

front: Which message has higher priority: Request QDM, turn left, or wind/QNH?
back: **Request QDM** (direction finding) > turn left (flight safety) > wind/QNH (meteorological).

front: What are distress conditions?
back: Aircraft and passengers face a **grave and imminent threat** and require immediate assistance.

back: About the safety of an aircraft, vehicle, or person **in sight**; no immediate grave danger.

front: What transponder code is used for an emergency?
visual: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 150' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='0' y='0' width='320' height='150' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='28' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='17' fill='#17324d'>Emergency</text><rect x='18' y='48' width='126' height='70' rx='9' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#2673a8' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='176' y='48' width='126' height='70' rx='9' fill='#e3f3e5' stroke='#39834a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='81' y='79' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' fill='#17324d'>Squawk</text><text x='81' y='99' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>KEY FACT</text><path d='M148 83 L169 83 M162 76 L169 83 L162 90' fill='none' stroke='#dd7818' stroke-width='3'/><text x='239' y='79' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' fill='#17324d'>7700</text><text x='239' y='99' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>RECALL</text><text x='160' y='139' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17324d'>RADIO MEMORY AID</text></svg>
